title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・再始動

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki wins the autumn Tenno Sho in a stunning victory and gives the audience a show to remember, just like she promised.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's even more excited than usual after the race. It seems she's finally grasped something important as an entertainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Arima Kinen. Her show is finally nearing its climax…
